title: wkcv OpenCV Tools — T1 Core
desc: Image/camera analysis via OpenCV: gaps (OCR masking), findtext (text detection), segment (contours/regions), room (brightness/motion)
steps: ## wkcv gaps — OCR Masking
Mask detected text and UI regions to measure and raise transparency.
wkcv gaps IMAGE.png                    # Mask OCR + a11y regions
wkcv gaps IMAGE.png --out result.png    # Save masked output
wkcv gaps IMAGE.png --ocr               # Mask only OCR, skip a11y
wkcv gaps IMAGE.png --json              # JSON output with transparency %
## wkcv findtext — Text Detection
Extract text elements with bounding boxes (Tesseract OCR).
wkcv findtext IMAGE.png                         # Human-readable output
wkcv findtext IMAGE.png --json                  # JSON output per element
wkcv findtext IMAGE.png --region 0 0 640 480    # Crop before OCR
## wkcv segment — Image Segmentation (NEW)
Find contours and extract bounding boxes for image regions.
wkcv segment IMAGE.png                                  # Contour detection
wkcv segment IMAGE.png --threshold 127                  # Binary threshold (0-255)
wkcv segment IMAGE.png --min-area 100                   # Minimum pixel area
wkcv segment IMAGE.png --method component               # Connected components method
wkcv segment IMAGE.png --json                           # JSON per region
wkcv segment IMAGE.png --csv                            # CSV output
Output: region id, bbox (x,y,w,h), area, center (x,y).
## wkcv room — Room Analysis
Analyze room brightness, motion, and clutter from camera.
wkcv room                  # Use default camera (index 0)
wkcv room 1                # Use camera index 1
## Dependencies
opencv-python, numpy, Tesseract OCR, Pillow.
